name: Daniel
title: Daniel — Kingdoms Fall; God’s Kingdom Stands
tagline: The Most High rules the kingdoms of men.

author.traditional: Daniel (debated critically; book presents 6th cent. setting).

date.range_display: Setting: Babylon/Persia. Composition: traditional 6th cent.; critical late 2nd cent. — USMC reading takes the book’s self-presentation seriously as revelation, not mere crisis fiction.
date.debate: Setting: Babylon/Persia. Composition: traditional 6th cent.; critical late 2nd cent. — USMC reading takes the book’s self-presentation seriously as revelation, not mere crisis fiction.

audience: Exiles and all under pagan power.
purpose: Fortify faithfulness; unveil God’s sovereignty over empires.
christ: Son of Man (7:13–14 → Gospels); stone that smashes kingdoms (2).
spirit: Wisdom and revelation in hostile courts.
jesus_in_this_book: Son of Man (7:13–14 → Gospels); stone that smashes kingdoms (2).
how_to_read: Stories train the spine; visions train the hope.
watchman_charge: Resolve not to defile yourself. Kneel when the decree forbids prayer.
mbt_note: Primary voice NKJV; parallels as engine shows.
